capabilities.title: VFX
capabilities.subtitle: If you can imagine it, we can create it
capabilities.description: Our team of artists, technologists, and producers crafts stunning photo-real visual effects. From condensation on a smartphone to a submarine breaching icy waters, we combine artistry with cutting-edge tools to bring any vision to life.

capabilities.title: Immersive Experiences
capabilities.subtitle: Beyond screens, into spaces
capabilities.description: We utilize cutting-edge technologies to craft immersive reality experiences for spatial computing and immersive architecture. Our projects range from interactive virtual worlds to architectural LED volumetric displays.

capabilities.title: Design
capabilities.subtitle: Intentional, memorable, evocative
capabilities.description: Applying design thinking to everything we do, we approach each project with care and consideration to create impactful, memorable work. We believe in visual clarity, bold aesthetics, and refined motion.

capabilities.title: Color
capabilities.subtitle: Shaping tone, mood, and cinematic texture
capabilities.description: Our world-class colorists bring distinctive aesthetic sensibility and technical mastery to every shot, establishing nuanced palettes that elevate storytelling across film, commercials, and digital media.

capabilities.title: Original Content
capabilities.subtitle: Artistic exploration and storytelling
capabilities.description: We develop and create original media and entertainment, from award-winning short films to interactive experiences and games. Utilizing the latest technology, we craft narratives that inspire and challenge conventions.

capabilities.title: Consulting
capabilities.subtitle: Strategic guidance for the future
capabilities.description: Bringing visionary ideas to life requires harnessing the latest techniques. Our expertise extends to consulting, helping brands develop forward-thinking pipelines, cloud workflows, and AI integration.

technology.title: Artificial Intelligence
technology.description: We leverage machine learning and neural networks not to replace human creativity, but to amplify artistic capability and streamline compute-heavy workflows.

technology.title: Born In The Cloud
technology.description: 100% cloud-native from day one. Artists across New York, Los Angeles, London, and Cape Town collaborate with zero latency on enterprise AWS and WEKA infrastructure.

technology.title: Real-Time Rendering
technology.description: Harnessing Unreal Engine and custom GPU clusters, we achieve real-time photorealistic preview and final-pixel output, collapsing turnaround times from days to seconds.

technology.title: Research & Innovation
technology.description: Our R&D team continuously builds custom plugins, procedural Houdini setups, and proprietary pipelines that push the envelope of visual possibilities.

technology.title: Strategic Technology Partnerships
technology.description: Collaborating directly with Autodesk, Epic Games, AWS, and leading hardware innovators to test alpha tools and influence future VFX standards.

technology.title: Visual Engineering
technology.description: Bridging mathematical precision with fine art. Every simulation, particle system, and digital double is engineered for physical truth and emotional resonance.

technology.title: ACES Compliance & Industry Standards
technology.description: Complete color-managed Academy Color Encoding System (ACES) workflows ensure flawless cross-facility fidelity from capture to final theatrical delivery.
